remarks: Welcome to 31 Selleck Place -- a captivating vintage Colonial in a fabulous location (halfway between the schools and town) at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac! The house has a fresh young vibe and is brimming with character and charm. The setting is picture perfect, too, framed by beautiful shrubs and trees and featuring a gorgeous umbrella pine tree, colorful perennial gardens and a spacious stone terrace that is the most wonderful place to relax and entertain!   The home has been lovingly cared for and is freshly painted both inside and out. On the first floor are light-filled formal rooms, a quaint country kitchen, an inviting screened porch and a guest room, or alternate master. Upstairs are three more bedrooms, including the master suite, plus an office. The partially finished lower level is plumbed for a bath and ready to become an ensuite bedroom room, family room or whatever kind of room you'd like it to be -- and it walks out onto a stone patio and the best backyard in the neighborhood!
